newsitem.title: USA: American spokesman - talks with pilots ongoing.
newsitem.headline: American spokesman - talks with pilots ongoing.

text.p: American Airlines spokesman Chris Chiames said contract negotiations with the Allied Pilots Association were continuing but he declined to characterize the nature of the talks.
"Negotiations have continued all night. ... It's a rotating situation, it's a dynamic situation, so negotiations have continued," he told reporters.
"I'm not going to confirm any of the details about the status or the type of negotiations."
Earlier Friday, Federal mediator Kenneth Hipp said he was somewhat more encouraged by the negotiations to avert a strike threatened for midnight (0500 GMT Saturday).
But Hipp said that while some progress had been made, "there are major points that have to be resolved between now and midnight."
Chiames said the flow of information to the media from the airline would be cut back. "It's unlikely that you'll see us making statements throughout the course of the day.
He expressed frustration with members of the pilots' union who were talking to the media and discussing the position of American Airlines, a unit of AMR Corp.
"If something has not been accepted it does not mean it has been rejected," Chiames said of bargaining, emphasizing it was all part of the give and take of negotiating.
Chiames also said there had been no further cancellations of American flights beyond the 240 international flights and a "handful" of domestic flights that were previously announced.
